title: Feature grid
brief: Ledgerly is accounting software for small businesses, and our features page needs a clean overview section. At the top, a simple header: the Ledgerly name on the left, links to Features, Pricing and Customers, and a solid 'Start free trial' link in our teal. Below, a centred introduction: a small 'Features' label, the heading 'Everything your books need, in one place' and one sentence about closing the month faster. Then six feature cards in a grid of three across and two down. Each card gets a simple line icon on a soft teal tile, a short title and about two lines of description. The six features are Smart invoicing, Bank sync, Receipt capture, Live reports, Tax ready and Team access. It should feel tidy, light and trustworthy.

requirements.text: A header with the Ledgerly name, three links (Features, Pricing, Customers) and a 'Start free trial' link styled as a solid button
A centred intro with the label 'Features', the heading 'Everything your books need, in one place' and one sentence
Six feature cards laid out three across and two down
Cards in this order: Smart invoicing, Bank sync, Receipt capture, Live reports, Tax ready, Team access
Each card has an icon drawn as inline SVG, a title and about two lines of text
Icons sit on a soft tinted square tile and match each feature's meaning
The cards are a list, each title is a heading below the page heading
Cards are white with a thin border and rounded corners on a very light page
Text is easy to read against its background

keyFacts: Everything your books need, in one place
designNotes: tidy and light, lots of white space
teal used only for the label, icons and trial link
equal white cards with thin borders
three across, two down on a wide screen
